title: A Schrödinger-like equation for the Thermodynamics of a particle in a box
summary: The particle in an expanding/contracting 1-dimension box is revisited in action-angle like variables with direct thermodynamic interpretation. An angle dependent potential is proposed accurately describing the mechanical behavior while also capturing thermodynamic evolution -- entropy production -- within a canonical Hamiltonian framework. Heat transfer at constant volume is analyzed, and the derived thermal conductance matches the universal quantum of heat conductance $G_{Q}$ in the quantum limit.
